en: Parivāra 6.
The Section on Questions on the Khandhakas.
I shall ask about full ordination, together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
How many offenses are there for the most eminent cases?
I shall explain the full ordination together with its origin and its exposition:
for the most eminent cases, there are two offenses.
I shall ask about the Uposatha together with its origin and its detailed exposition;
how many offenses are there in the most excellent phrases?
I shall answer regarding the Uposatha together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
Regarding the most elevated terms, there are three offenses.
I shall inquire about the entry into the rains residence, together with its origin and its detailed exposition:
how many offenses are there for the most elevated terms?
I shall explain the commencement of the rains-retreat together with its origin and its detailed exposition;
there is one offense for the most elevated [form].
I shall ask about the invitation ceremony together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
How many offenses are there for the most excellent phrases?
I shall explain the invitation ceremony together with its origin and its exposition:
for the most excellent phrases, there are three offenses.
I shall ask concerning the section on leather, together with its origin and its exposition;
how many offenses are there in the most excellent passages?
I shall answer concerning the section on leather, together with its origin and its exposition.
Regarding the most prominent phrases:
"I will ask about medicine, together with its origin and its detailed exposition"—
how many offenses are there for these most prominent phrases?
I shall explain the relinquishing of medicine, together with its origin and its detailed exposition;
the three offenses regarding the most excellent items.
I shall inquire concerning the kaṭhina cloth, together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
How many offenses are there for the most outstanding cases?
I shall explain the Kathina procedure together with its origin story and its detailed exposition:
for the most outstanding cases, there is no offense therein.
I shall ask concerning the robe-related [rules], together with their origins and detailed explanations;
how many offenses are there for the most elevated categories?
I shall answer concerning the robe-related [rules], together with their origins and detailed explanations.
There are three offenses for the most elevated rules.
I shall ask about the Campeyyaka rule together with its origin and its exposition:
how many offenses are there for the most elevated rules?
I shall explain the Campeyyaka case together with its origin and its exposition;
it consists of one offense among the most elevated instances.
I shall ask about the Kosambaka case together with its origin and its exposition.
How many offenses are there for the most prominent cases?
I shall explain the Kosambaka case together with its introduction and its exposition:
for the most prominent cases, there is one offense.
I shall ask about the Kammakkhandhaka together with its origin and its exposition;
how many offenses are there in its most excellent passages?
I shall answer regarding the Kammakkhandhaka together with its origin and its exposition.
There is one offense for the most prominent terms.
"I shall ask about the one on probation, together with its origin and its exposition;
how many offenses are there for the most prominent terms?"
I shall explain the one who is on probation (pārivāsika), together with its origin and its detailed exposition;
there is one offense for the most prominent terms.
I shall ask about the compendium, together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
Regarding the "Exalted Words," how many offenses are there?
I shall provide the answer for the compendium, together with its introduction and its exposition:
for the Exalted Words, there is one offense.
I shall ask about settling (samatha), together with its origin and its exposition,
and how many offenses there are for the most excellent terms;
I shall answer regarding settling, together with its origin and its exposition.
There are two offenses for the "Exalted Words.
I shall ask about the Minor Matters, together with their origins and their detailed explanations:
How many offenses are there for the "Exalted Words"?
I shall explain the *Khuddakavatthu* together with its introduction and its exposition;
there are three offenses regarding the most excellent words.
I shall inquire about the lodging together with its introduction and its exposition.
For the most elevated phrases, how many offenses are there?
"I shall relinquish the lodging," together with its introduction and its exposition—
for these most elevated phrases, there are three offenses.
I shall ask about the schism in the Saṅgha, together with its origin and its detailed exposition;
how many offenses are there for those who have uttered the most elevated words?
I shall answer regarding the schism in the Saṅgha, together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
Regarding the questions on proper conduct with their origins and detailed explanations:
how many offenses are there for the most excellent words?
I shall explain the proper conduct together with its origin and its detailed exposition;
there is one offense for the most excellent words.
I shall ask concerning the setting aside [of an act], together with its origin and its detailed exposition.
How many offenses are there for the most elevated terms?
I shall explain the setting aside, together with its origin and its exposition:
for the most elevated terms, there is one offense.
I shall ask about the Bhikkhunikkhandhaka together with its introduction and its exposition:
how many offenses are there in its most eminent passages?
I shall answer the Bhikkhunikkhandhaka together with its introduction and its exposition.
Regarding the *Samukkaṭṭhapadāna*, there are two offenses.
I shall ask about the five hundred [rules], together with their origins and detailed explanations:
how many offenses are there in the *Samukkaṭṭhapadāna*?
I shall explain the five-hundred [questions] together with their origins and their detailed expositions;
there is no offense therein regarding the most excellent phrases.
I shall ask the seven-hundred [questions] together with their origins and their detailed expositions.
Regarding the most excellent phrases, how many offenses are there?
I shall provide the answer for the seven hundred [phrases], including their origins and their detailed explanations:
regarding the most excellent phrases, there are no offenses therein.

The first section, the Questioning on the Khandhakas, is finished. Its summary verse: Ordination, the Uposatha, ... (the rest of the uddāna follows) ... 195. The first section, the Questioning on the Khandhakas, is finished. Its summary verse: Ordination, the Uposatha,
The invitation at the commencement of the rains;
hides, medicines, and the kaṭhina robe;
and the Campaka robe.
The Kosaṃbakkhandhaka, the formal act (kamma),
the compendium on those undergoing probation (pārivāsika),
the minor matters of settlement (samatha), and the army.
The conduct leading to schism in the Saṅgha;
the setting aside of the group of bhikkhunīs;
and [the account] with five hundred and seven hundred.
